name: The Zombie's Revenge v26.4.1
desc:
We're working with Roblox to undo the 16+ Age limit.

The Rogothian Empire stands on the edge of collapse. The Deluge has begun. Cities drown, enemies gather, and only those willing to rise from nothing will carve their place in history.

The hubris of the Dedsfang Dominion has gone unpunished for much too long. 
This war will decide everything.
And when it ends… perhaps there will finally be peace.

•⚔️Earn every weapon, every piece of armor, every upgrade, nothing is handed to you. You must prove your worth to the Empire, through badges and story completions.
•📜Fight through the Deluge campaign, face off an army by yourself or hold the line alongside your comrades.
•🦿Push beyond human limits with experimental cybernetic augmentations never meant for the average soldier.. Become powerful enough to claim the mettle of a legendary HERO yourself!!

🏅The Empire rewards those who endure:

+50% XP & Tokens on weekends
Premium: -5% XP Requirement.
